description_en: Queries the information about a specific version of a driver
description_zh: 查询驱动某一版本的信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-edge-driver-version --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --driver-id fec565038d7544978d9aed5c1a000000 --driver-version 1.2.0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetEdgeDriverVersion

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The driver ID. On the **Driver Management** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the driver ID.
parameters.description_zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
